facts.fact: The Internet Society Foundation announced on 2026-02-26 a 2025 Sustainable Peering Infrastructure grant to upgrade the switching fabric of the Lilongwe Open Neutral Internet Exchange (LIONEX) in Malawi for higher port speeds that benefit current peers and let more members join; no member count is given, and the date is the announcement's.

MISPA states the Malawi Internet Exchange (MIX) at the College of Medicine in Blantyre became operational on 4 December 2008, with Broadband/Burco, the College of Medicine and Malawi SDNP peering at start-up.

MISPA's table of 14 November 2024 shows 11 networks peering at the MIX at the College of Medicine and 9 (TNM, Afrimax, Airtel, Globe, INQ, MAREN, MTL, OCL, Simbanet) already peering after its migration to the National Data Centre.
The Internet Society says that in Malawi the Lilongwe Internet Exchange (LLIX) launched with five peers; the article gives no launch date, so its published date 2026-07-13 is used.

note: Document does not say whether LLIX is the same as LIONEX.

facts.fact: A MACRA Director General slide deck states Malawi has one IXP, in Blantyre (Southern region); the deck is undated and its latest internal date is September 2023, so 2023-10 is a proxy.
The MACRA deck states Malawi has only one IXP, in Blantyre; no networks from abroad are mentioned; the deck is undated, latest internal date September 2023, so 2023-10 is a proxy.

note: Lilongwe and Mzuzu IXPs are planned: MACRA was procuring equipment for MISPA.
Names exchanges only in South Africa, Kenya and Nigeria; nothing on Malawi's exchange points.

systems.system: LIONEX Lilongwe facility (leaf-spine EVPN-VXLAN fabric, Cloudflare CDN)

note: LinkedIn post by LIONEX (2025-12-21) describes a new switching fabric and a CDN installed but not yet live; it does not state that an exchange point is in service, that networks peer, or that a cache sits at an exchange.
Regional keynote on NRENs; states nothing this study asks for this country.

facts.fact: The Internet Society says it granted funds in 2023 to an IXP in Malawi, where the ISP association MISPA will install a second IXP at Lilongwe (LLIX) for the central region.

note: Second IXP at Lilongwe is planned, not in service.

facts.fact: MISPA's chair says the Malawi Internet Exchange (MIX), owned and operated by the ISP association since 2008, keeps local traffic local, with all ISPs connected and peering on a route server.
MISPA's chair says the MIX provides international CDN caches from Google, Facebook and Akamai.

systems.platform: internet exchange point, in equipment procurement

facts.fact: The African IXP Association's undated list of exchange points, retrieved 2026-11-09, names for Malawi: MIX, Blantyre, and LIONEX, Lilongwe.
The African IXP Association's undated list, retrieved 2026-11-09, places Malawi's exchange points in more than one city: Blantyre and Lilongwe.
Internet Society's report counts two IXPs in Malawi, with 29.03% of local networks connected.
